title: Report opens with the tile's preset selected, not Custom
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Click the report icon beside Revenue (pill on This Month).
  3. Read the report's Date control (e.g. Date: This month), then click it and read the dates it covers.
  4. Go back to the Dashboard.
  5. Repeat for Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization (each on This Month) and Sales by Customer (on Last 12 Months).
  6. Set the Revenue pill to Last Quarter and click the report icon beside Revenue.
  7. Read the report's Date control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Sales report opens with This month selected in its Date control, not Custom.
  • Service Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization open with This month selected, and Sales By Customer opens with Last 12 months selected; none shows Custom.
  • With Revenue on Last Quarter, the Sales report opens with Last quarter selected, not Custom.
  • Write down the exact words each Date control shows; do not pass or fail on capitalisation (the tile pill reads This Month, the report reads This month).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9582 (Story 10, Report Drill-In); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 10. QA raised 2026-10-05, ruled the same day (PRD context note). Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 10_sales_After to 13_technician-utilization_After (report Date control reads Date: This year), used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R5: “When the tile's date range is a preset the report also offers, the report's date-range control opens with that preset selected. It does not show "Custom". Example: a Revenue tile on This Month opens the Sales report with "This month" selected.”
